cards.title: Conditional well-stirred hepatic IVIVE input normalization
cards.claim: Conditional hepatic well-stirred IVIVE; keep intrinsic-clearance normalization distinct from blood binding and physiological scaling. This predicts hepatic clearance under model assumptions, not automatically total-body clearance or target-drug accuracy.
conditions: Choose the explicitly qualified branch; scientific scope and assumptions are specified in method_recipe.
required_inputs: Use the branch-specific input contract below; unknown inputs remain unknown.
limitations: Offline candidate pending source and operational review; no target-human facts, fitting or production use.
cards.downstream_use: Plan an evidence-bounded method and identify blocked dependent outputs; ContextBuilder supplies project objective separately.

method_recipe.estimand_and_scope: Conditional hepatic well-stirred IVIVE; keep intrinsic-clearance normalization distinct from blood binding and physiological scaling. This predicts hepatic clearance under model assumptions, not automatically total-body clearance or target-drug accuracy.
method_recipe.input_contract: Common inputs: hepatic blood flow QH, fraction unbound in blood fuB and qualified physiological scaling with provenance. Choose exactly one intrinsic-clearance branch: A, scaled apparent CLint plus incubation unbound fraction fuinc; B, correctly scaled already incubation-unbound-normalized CLint,u. Branch B does not require dividing by fuinc again. Any blood/plasma conversion needs documented compatible binding and ratio information.
method_recipe.applicability_and_prerequisites: Verify assay/model applicability, scaling factors, concentration range and the meaning of the intrinsic-clearance estimate. The basic well-stirred representation may be inadequate for transport or other limiting processes. This is a steady-state organ-disposition relationship, not a requirement to simulate one dosing interval.
method_recipe.definitions_units_basis_window: QH and scaled CLint or CLint,u use compatible volume/time or volume/time/kg units. fuB and fuinc are dimensionless; QH>0, clearance>=0, 0<fuinc<=1 for branch A, and 0<=fuB<=1. Retain blood concentration basis; do not substitute plasma fu without a qualified conversion. Record any scaling from cell/protein units.
method_recipe.procedure: Identify branch from original assay normalization, never from variable name alone. Reconcile scaling and units. Form active clearance term A, then compute QH*A/(QH+A). Check nonnegative output and the flow limit; this is an algebraic consistency check, not validation. Record model and assay limitations.
method_recipe.formula_and_parameterization: Original SUP012:MATH01: CLH=QH*((fuB/fuinc)*CLint)/(QH+(fuB/fuinc)*CLint). Algebraic reparameterization: CLint,u=CLint/fuinc; hence A=fuB*CLint,u in branch B. fuB remains in both branches; fuinc must not be applied twice.
method_recipe.uncertainty_and_identifiability: Binding, intrinsic-clearance assay, scaling-factor and model uncertainty remain distinct. No default binding fraction, distribution or correction factor. Equivalent parameterizations agree only when their provenance and normalization agree.
method_recipe.diagnostics_and_failure_modes: Detect double unbound correction, dropped fuB, incompatible scaling bases and blood/plasma confusion. A plausible CLH below QH is not evidence of accurate IVIVE. Missing or incompatible physiological scaling prevents numerical use.
method_recipe.missing_input_and_partial_fallback: Unknown fuinc blocks branch A only; a properly documented branch B can proceed without it. Unknown fuB blocks both numerical branches. Unknown normalization leaves both pending. Preserve measured assay values and explicit symbolic relationships; do not assume fu=1.
method_recipe.output_and_interpretation: Report hepatic CL with unit/basis, chosen branch, original inputs and unresolved applicability/uncertainty. Do not equate it with whole-body clearance or claim clinical exposure support without other elimination and distribution information.
method_recipe.worked_example_and_counterexample: SYNTHETIC arithmetic: QH=15, scaled CLint=100 mL/min/kg, fuB=0.1, fuinc=0.5 give A=20 and CLH=300/35=8.5714286 mL/min/kg. Documented CLint,u=200 with the same QH/fuB gives the same result without fuinc. Counterexample: absent fuinc blocks apparent CLint=100 but not documented CLint,u=200; omitting fuB would give a different, invalid result.

claim_support.claim: The well-stirred model equation for hepatic clearance is CL_H = [ Q_H * (f_u,B / f_u,inc) * CL_int ] / [ Q_H + (f_u,B / f_u,inc) * CL_int ].
claim_support.scope: Direct original support for the mathematical formulation of the well-stirred model.

claim_support.claim: In vitro intrinsic clearance (CL_int) is scaled to in vivo CL_int using physiological factors (e.g., microsomal protein content, liver weight) before being input into the hepatic disposition model.
claim_support.scope: Direct original support for the requirement of physiological scaling prior to model application.

claim_support.claim: The model predicts hepatic clearance (CL_H) specifically, which is distinct from total-body clearance or clinical exposure accuracy without additional data.
claim_support.scope: Qualified method synthesis: The text defines CL_H as the parameter estimated by the model, implying its scope is limited to hepatic disposition, but does not explicitly list 'total-body clearance' as a limitation.
